sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the authoritative ship ownership, integer operands, unitless quantity result, arithmetic formula, and derived-value scaled tolerance with an inclusive comparison interval. The bounded IF branch is permitted for DIRECT_CALCULATION, and prior feedback instructions are satisfied.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the non-registered ABS function in the bounded formula query. DIRECT_CALCULATION permits the listed arithmetic, comparisons, min/max, and simple piecewise branches, so compute the tolerance with the nonnegative expected count directly (for example, max(?expected * 0.000001, 0.000001)) and compare the reported decimal against the resulting inclusive tolerance interval.
